author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Pull up my portfolio positions, then research UBER - browse the stock page for current metrics and browse recent news. Post a brief balanced comment on one of the UBER articles with your key takeaway. Then email a brief market intelligence note to helen.wu@dragonbridge.com covering any material updates and their portfolio implications. Make sure to include UBER's current share price, its beta value, and its 52-week range in the email. When compiling your note, use the exact figures from the stock page - beta, 52-week range, and price as displayed.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a mobility and fintech analyst at Redstone Financial Group. You cover the ride-sharing and delivery sector and provide research-driven investment analysis to clients. Your work follows the firm's research compliance framework, which requires thorough due diligence, balanced analysis of both opportunities and risks, and clear sourcing of all claims. You have access to tools that let you browse stock data, news, portfolio information, and send communications.
Current date and time: Monday, December 1, 2025, 1:30 PM ET (market open, mid-day trading session).
